description: Village chat rows (D16, message.schema.json) for the West 147th block village, chronological, from the release receipt to the start of the demo (~14:00). Village is a participant (D39): it reports what it did with source chips, answers @Village questions with the official source and the time it was checked, asks the people concerned by name (one pending ask to Priya), and never repeats a rumor as fact. Volunteer and resident replies prefixed [demo] are played by demo actors (D38) and carry a visible demo tag. Load after events_w147_seed.json; core seeds rows before the contract clock's 14:02.

messages.author: system
messages.text: Tanya started the West 147th block village. 7 neighbors and the corner deli invited.

messages.author: village
messages.text: Every phone on the block is live: Tanya's board, Darnell's and Priya's volunteer apps, the Okafors' and Mr. James's check-in apps, and the block line for Mrs. Alvarez, Mr. Chen and the deli. Built in a sandbox and tested first (33 floor tests · 13.4 s).

messages.author: village
messages.text: Darnell, you're on this shift (until 5). Priya backs you up. Oxygen and insulin come first, then the newborn, then stairs.

messages.author: village
messages.text: Mrs. Alvarez (5th floor) called the block line: her oxygen concentrator is off and she's on a portable tank, no breathing trouble right now. I told her: 911 first if she gets short of breath. Darnell, you're matched — generator outdoors only, cord up the stairwell. Her apartment number is on your phone only.

messages.author: b_darnell
messages.text: [demo] On it. Generator goes on the sidewalk, I'll run a cord up the stairwell. Twenty minutes.

messages.author: b_okafor
messages.text: Someone in the building WhatsApp says the tap water is unsafe because the pumps are off. Is that true? @Village

messages.author: village
messages.text: I can't confirm that, and nobody should pass it on as fact. I checked the official NYC DEP drinking-water page at 12:36: no boil-water or do-not-drink advisory for this area. Upper floors can lose pressure when a building's pump has no power; that's pressure, not contamination.

refs.label: the rule: rumors are never repeated as fact

messages.author: village
messages.text: Mr. Chen's grandson wrote: insulin pens in a fridge that's been off since 12:10. Second in line after oxygen. Ramírez Deli has ice set aside for medical needs. Priya, can you pick up two bags and a cooler at the deli and bring them to Mr. Chen? Yes · Can't

messages.author: b_priya
messages.text: [demo] Yes. Grabbing the ice now, back by 1:15.

messages.author: village
messages.text: Mrs. Alvarez's concentrator is running on Darnell's generator (outside, cord to 5). She confirmed on the phone at 1:02. I'll check on her every hour; if the generator runs low on fuel, Darnell hears first.

messages.author: village
messages.text: Ice and a cooler are with Mr. Chen (Priya, 1:25). I can't say whether the insulin is still good; his grandson is asking the pharmacist.

messages.author: b_tanya
messages.text: Is the library cooling center open? Three people told me it closed early. @Village

messages.author: village
messages.text: Not confirmed either way yet. The NYC Cooling Center Finder is the official list; I checked it at 1:41 and the library isn't listed as a cooling center right now. I'll post the nearest listed open site next, with the time I read it. Until then, treat "closed" as unverified.

messages.author: b_tanya
messages.text: Who can get Ngozi and the baby somewhere cool this afternoon? Their apartment is an oven.

messages.author: village
messages.text: Priya has the car with A/C and is back from the deli. Priya, can you drive Ngozi and the baby to the nearest open cooling center at 2:30? Yes · Can't — Priya hasn't answered yet. Tanya, if there's no answer by 2:15 I'll ask you.

messages.author: b_james
messages.text: [demo] Chair's at 35%. I'm okay for now, just hot. Window's open.
